modules.module_title: Carry out the quality control checks at leather goods and — Core Assessment Criteria

pcs.pc_description: inspect leather goods and accessories according to established quality standards and specifications.
identify and document any defects or irregularities in materials, stitching, finishing, or overall construction.
utilize appropriate measurement tools and techniques to assess dimensions, thickness, and other quality parameters of leather materials and components.
evaluate the color consistency, texture, and surface appearance of leather goods, ensuring adherence to desired aesthetic standards.
verify the functionality and durability of hardware components such as zippers, buttons, buckles, and straps.
perform tests and assessments to evaluate the strength, flexibility, and tear resistance of leather materials.
assess the stitching quality, seam strength, and stitch consistency of assembled leather products.
compare finished products against approved samples or prototypes to ensure consistency and compliance with design specifications.
record inspection findings accurately and comprehensively using standardized documentation or quality control forms.
communicate any quality issues or deviations from standards to relevant personnel, including supervisors, production staff, or suppliers.
collaborate with production teams to implement corrective actions and preventive measures to address quality issues and improve processes.
monitor and track quality metrics and performance indicators to identify trends, patterns, and areas for continuous improvement.
adhere to safety protocols and quality control procedures to ensure a safe and healthy working environment for all personnel involved in the manufacturing process.
maintain cleanliness and organization in the quality control area to facilitate efficient inspection processes and prevent contamination or damage to products.
participate in training and professional development activities to enhance knowledge and skills related to quality control practices in leather goods manufacturing.

modules.module_title: Carry out quality control checks on leather and non-leather — Core Assessment Criteria

pcs.pc_description: recognize the defects in both leather and non- leather garments during the quality control process.
assess the quality of materials used in garment production, including leather, synthetic materials, and accessories such as zippers and buttons.
demonstrate the visual inspections of garments to ensure they meet quality standards in terms of stitching, seams, alignment, and overall appearance.
ensure the garment measurements against specified dimensions to ensure accurate sizing and fit according to design requirements.
inspect finishing techniques such as dyeing, printing, embossing, and coating to ensure consistency, colorfastness, and uniformity.
carry out the tests to assess the durability and strength of seams, fastenings, and reinforcements to ensure garments withstand wear and tear.
check the functional features of garments, including pockets, closures, and adjustable elements, to ensure they operate smoothly and securely.
evaluate garment comfort and wearability factors such as fabric breathability, flexibility, and comfort against the intended use and customer expectations.
adhere to brand/customer quality standards and specifications throughout the quality control process to maintain consistency and compliance with industry regulations.
document the inspection findings accurately, including any defects or deviations from quality standards, to facilitate corrective actions and ensure traceability.
communicate the quality control findings effectively to relevant stakeholders, such as production teams or supervisors, to facilitate timely resolution of issues.
ensure the cleanliness and organization of the inspection area and equipment to prevent contamination and maintain a conducive working environment.

modules.module_title: Carry out quality checks on bags and luggage — Core Assessment Criteria

pcs.pc_description: conduct visual inspections of bags and luggage to identify any defects or irregularities in materials, stitching, and construction.
utilize appropriate measuring tools and techniques to ensure that dimensions and proportions of bags and luggage meet specifications.
perform functional tests on zippers, handles, wheels (if applicable), and other components to ensure proper operation and durability.
inspect hardware such as buckles, clasps, and straps for functionality, proper alignment, and secure attachment.
verify the accuracy and completeness of labeling, including brand labels, care labels, and product information tags.
check for color consistency and uniformity across different parts of the bag or luggage item.
assess the overall finish and appearance of the product, including smoothness of surfaces, absence of scratches or marks, and alignment of seams.
evaluate the strength and resilience of materials used, particularly in high-stress areas such as handles and straps.
document and record any quality issues or deviations from standards identified during the inspection process.
communicate findings effectively to relevant stakeholders, such as production teams or quality assurance managers, and collaborate on corrective actions as needed.

modules.module_title: Compliance with health, safety and security requirements at the workplace

pcs.pc_description: comply with health and safety-related instructions applicable to the workplace
use the personal protective equipment as per protocol
maintain a healthy lifestyle and guard against dependency on intoxicants
follow environment management system related procedures
monitor the workplace and work processes for potential risks and threats
carry out periodic walk-through to keep the work area free from hazards and obstructions, if assigned
report hazards and potential risks/ threats to supervisors or other authorized personnel
participate in mock drills/ evacuation procedures organized at the workplace
undertake first aid training, fire-fighting drill, and emergency response training, etc.,
take action based on instructions in the event of fire, emergencies or accidents
safely handle and move waste and debris
follow organization procedures for shutdown and evacuation when require

modules.module_title: Maintain hygiene and sanitation at the workplace

pcs.pc_description: maintain personal body hygiene and dental hygiene
follow social distancing at the workplace
ensure not to go to work if unwell, to avoid the risk of spreading an infection to other people
cover the mouth with an elbow/handkerchief or turn away from people while sneezing or coughing
ensure equipment, work area, restrooms, etc. are sanitized before and after sessions
ensure regular vaccinations to avoid any spreading of diseases
handle materials, machinery, equipment and tools safely and correctly
use correct lifting and handling procedures
use materials to minimize waste
Perform the cleaning of machine or tools at the end of each shift
carry out running maintenance within agreed schedules
report unsafe equipment and other dangerous occurrences
carry out works in a comfortable position with the correct posture
maintain proper lighting, and ventilation to make sure general comfort is there while working

modules.module_title: Compliance with industry, regulatory and organizational requirements

pcs.pc_description: carry out work functions in accordance with legislation and regulations, organizational guidelines, and procedures
seek and obtain clarifications on policies and procedures from the authorized personnel
follow the policies and procedures within the work practices
identify and report any possible deviation to these requirements
transact with everyone without any personal bias like gender, disability, caste, religion, color, sexual orientation, and culture
identify the indicators of harassment and discrimination
report incidents of harassment and discrimination to appropriate authority
respect the personal and professional space of others
identify ways to optimize the usage of material including water in various activities /processes
check for spills/leakages in various processes and plug the spills and leakages
use the optimized amount of chemicals that have petroleum products (adhesives, leather chemicals, chrome salt, cleaning agents, IPA, etc.)
use proper PPE when in contact with the above materials as per specifications
identify ways to optimize the usage of electricity/energy in various activities/processes
check if the equipment/machine is generally functioning before commencing work and rectify wherever required
ensure electrical equipment and appliances are properly connected and turned off when not in use
identify recyclable and non-recyclable, and hazardous waste generated
segregate waste into different categories
dispose of non-recyclable waste appropriately
deposit recyclable and reusable material at the identified location
follow processes specified for disposal of hazardous waste
